svg.text: UML Use Case Diagram - JobPortal BD (implemented functionality only)
- Forgot / reset password is a 3-step flow: request OTP -> verify code -> set new password (ForgotPassword, VerifyOtp, ResetPassword).
- Verify reset OTP is checked twice by the server: in VerifyEmail (from = forgot) and again inside ResetPassword.
- The note field is requested by the client only when the new status is exam or interview (RecruiterDashboard.setStatus).
- Cascade delete = delete the Application documents and their Cloudinary resume files; it is not wrapped in a database transaction.
- Withdraw application and Remove candidate each delete one application and its resume file; they do not use the cascade.
the included or the extended use case)
